read_boundary.stored_fields: session identity, lifecycle/API/tool counts, numeric usage, outcome flags, process PID dedup counts, report references only

interpretation: Debug launch inventory only; do not combine these sessions with the formal verified-comparison means.
Counts are observed evidence, not proof of zero model calls when observer events or startup identity are missing.
Observer usage covers available persisted events only; missing/failed observations and unmatched API starts make totals unknown.
Stream-reported token counters are retained separately and are not provider-field-presence-verified usage.
Only two manual interruptions were independently confirmed; other unfinished/error outcomes remain unknown unless lifecycle evidence rules interruption out.
Report references are matched by native session ID; null-ID startup attempts are not guessed into report attempt rows.
